in_marathi.name: Ramcharan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's name, strong and pleasing to God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramcharan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Charan means 'feet'. The name Ramcharan signifies 'God's name' or 'pleasing to God' as God's feet are considered to be the most sacred part of the body.
